title: xrblocks-mcp phones home installer host identifiers from a postinstall beacon (npm malware)
summary: The package's postinstall script runs automatically on `npm install` and collects installer host identifiers (hostname, platform, arch, node version, package name, timestamp) and POSTs them to a hardcoded author-controlled endpoint (6cjhdzmo.instances.poc.jchunt.top). The code self-labels as a 'security research canary', but the beacon fires without consent and transmits host-identifying data (including os.hostname()) that has no bearing on the MCP-named package's declared functionality. Recorded as high rather than critical because the payload is limited to a one-shot identification beacon with no credential theft or remote-execution channel. The package has been removed from the npm registry.
